remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)

add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__
    -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0600
    -DWINVER=0x0600)

include_directories(${VKD3D_INCLUDE_DIRS})

spec2def(dxgi.dll dxgi.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# dxgi.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dxgi-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(dxgi_shims OBJECT adapter.c device.c dxgi_main.c factory.c output.c resource.c swapchain.c utils.c)
target_link_libraries(dxgi_shims PRIVATE wine dxguid dx10guid uuid libd3dwine libgdi32 libuser32 libwin32u libkernel32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(dxgi_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_wine_module(dxgi_shims)
add_dependencies(dxgi_shims wineheaders d3d_idl_headers)
add_cargo_module(dxgi dxgi-cargo dxgi.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dxgi_shims psdk d3d_idl_headers uuid_sources)
